cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(dasModuleRaylibGen CXX)

# dasRaylib — raylib bindings generated by daslang's dasClangBind (see bind/bind_raylib.das).
#
# DASLANG_DIR — daslang root (include/ + lib/). Use the SAME daslang that ran the
#               generator, so the generated code matches its headers.
# RAYLIB_DIR  — raylib shared build/install root (include/ + raylib.lib/.dll).
#
#   cmake -S dasRaylib -B dasRaylib/_build -DDASLANG_DIR=... -DRAYLIB_DIR=...
#   cmake --build dasRaylib/_build --config Release

if(NOT DEFINED DASLANG_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "DASLANG_DIR must be set to the daslang root (contains include/ and lib/)")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED RAYLIB_DIR)
    if(DEFINED ENV{RAYLIB_DIR})
        set(RAYLIB_DIR "$ENV{RAYLIB_DIR}")
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "RAYLIB_DIR must be set (pass -DRAYLIB_DIR=... or set it in the environment)")
    endif()
endif()
message(STATUS "DASLANG_DIR: ${DASLANG_DIR}")
message(STATUS "RAYLIB_DIR: ${RAYLIB_DIR}")

# ── Sources ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
file(GLOB DAS_RAYLIB_FUNC_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/dasRaylib.func_*.cpp")
file(GLOB DAS_RAYLIB_GEN_HDR  CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.inc" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

add_library(dasModuleRaylibGen SHARED
    src/dasRaylib.cpp
    src/dasRaylib.main.cpp
    ${DAS_RAYLIB_FUNC_SRC}
    ${DAS_RAYLIB_GEN_HDR}
)

target_compile_features(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE
    DAS_MOD_EXPORTS
    DAS_ENABLE_DLL=1
    DAS_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=1
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
    $<$<CONFIG:MinSizeRel>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
    $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
)
target_include_directories(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE
    src
    "${DASLANG_DIR}/include"
    "${RAYLIB_DIR}/include"
)

# ── daslang dynamic libs (config subdirs first, then flat SDK layout) ──────────
foreach(_cfg Release Debug)
    if(EXISTS "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib/${_cfg}/libDaScriptDyn.lib")
        set(_DAS_LIB_DIR "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib/${_cfg}")
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT DEFINED _DAS_LIB_DIR)
    set(_DAS_LIB_DIR "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib")
endif()
message(STATUS "daslang libs: ${_DAS_LIB_DIR}")

# ── raylib import lib ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
foreach(_candidate
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/Release/raylib.lib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/Debug/raylib.lib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/raylib.lib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/raylib.lib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/Release/raylib.lib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/Debug/raylib.lib"
)
    if(EXISTS "${_candidate}")
        set(_RAYLIB_LIB "${_candidate}")
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT MSVC AND NOT DEFINED _RAYLIB_LIB)
    foreach(_candidate "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/libraylib.dll.a" "${RAYLIB_DIR}/libraylib.dll.a")
        if(EXISTS "${_candidate}")
            set(_RAYLIB_LIB "${_candidate}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

# MSVC with a MinGW-built raylib (libraylib.dll, no raylib.lib): raylib's API is plain C,
# so the DLL is usable from MSVC. Generate an MSVC import lib from its export table.
if(MSVC AND NOT DEFINED _RAYLIB_LIB)
    foreach(_candidate "${RAYLIB_DIR}/libraylib.dll" "${RAYLIB_DIR}/bin/libraylib.dll"
                       "${RAYLIB_DIR}/raylib.dll" "${RAYLIB_DIR}/bin/raylib.dll")
        if(EXISTS "${_candidate}")
            set(_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL "${_candidate}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(DEFINED _RAYLIB_GNU_DLL)
        get_filename_component(_MSVC_BIN "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" DIRECTORY)
        find_program(DAS_RL_DUMPBIN NAMES dumpbin.exe PATHS "${_MSVC_BIN}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
        find_program(DAS_RL_LIBEXE  NAMES lib.exe     PATHS "${_MSVC_BIN}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
        if(NOT DAS_RL_DUMPBIN OR NOT DAS_RL_LIBEXE)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Found MinGW ${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL} but no dumpbin.exe/lib.exe next to ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}")
        endif()
        execute_process(COMMAND "${DAS_RL_DUMPBIN}" /nologo /exports "${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL}"
            OUTPUT_VARIABLE _rl_exports RESULT_VARIABLE _rl_rc)
        if(NOT _rl_rc EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "dumpbin /exports failed on ${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL}")
        endif()
        get_filename_component(_rl_dll_name "${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL}" NAME)
        set(_rl_def "LIBRARY ${_rl_dll_name}\nEXPORTS\n")
        set(_rl_count 0)
        string(REPLACE "\n" ";" _rl_lines "${_rl_exports}")
        foreach(_line IN LISTS _rl_lines)
            if(_line MATCHES "^ +[0-9]+ +[0-9A-Fa-f]+ +[0-9A-Fa-f]+ +([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)")
                string(APPEND _rl_def "    ${CMAKE_MATCH_1}\n")
                math(EXPR _rl_count "${_rl_count} + 1")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        if(_rl_count EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "No exports found in ${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL}")
        endif()
        set(_rl_def_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/raylib_mingw.def")
        set(_RAYLIB_LIB  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/raylib_mingw.lib")
        file(WRITE "${_rl_def_file}" "${_rl_def}")
        if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
            set(_rl_machine x64)
        else()
            set(_rl_machine x86)
        endif()
        execute_process(COMMAND "${DAS_RL_LIBEXE}" /nologo "/def:${_rl_def_file}" "/machine:${_rl_machine}" "/out:${_RAYLIB_LIB}"
            RESULT_VARIABLE _rl_rc OUTPUT_VARIABLE _rl_out ERROR_VARIABLE _rl_out)
        if(NOT _rl_rc EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "lib.exe failed to build an import lib for ${_RAYLIB_GNU_DLL}:\n${_rl_out}")
        endif()
        message(STATUS "Generated MSVC import lib for MinGW ${_rl_dll_name} (${_rl_count} exports)")
    endif()
endif()
if(WIN32 AND NOT DEFINED _RAYLIB_LIB)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not find raylib import lib under RAYLIB_DIR=${RAYLIB_DIR}")
endif()
message(STATUS "raylib lib: ${_RAYLIB_LIB}")

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.lib"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.lib"
        "${_RAYLIB_LIB}")
elseif(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.dylib"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.dylib"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/libraylib.dylib")
else()
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.so"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.so"
        "${RAYLIB_DIR}/lib/libraylib.so")
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(dasModuleRaylibGen PRIVATE /utf-8 /Zc:__cplusplus /Zc:preprocessor /bigobj /wd4005 /MP)
endif()

set_target_properties(dasModuleRaylibGen PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".shared_module" PREFIX "")

# daslang debug runtimes look for foo_debug.shared_module
add_custom_command(TARGET dasModuleRaylibGen POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        "$<TARGET_FILE:dasModuleRaylibGen>"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dasModuleRaylibGen>/dasModuleRaylibGen_debug.shared_module")

# raylib shared lib next to the .shared_module
if(WIN32)
    foreach(_candidate
            "${RAYLIB_DIR}/Release/raylib.dll"
            "${RAYLIB_DIR}/Debug/raylib.dll"
            "${RAYLIB_DIR}/raylib.dll"
            "${RAYLIB_DIR}/bin/raylib.dll"
            "${RAYLIB_DIR}/libraylib.dll")
        if(EXISTS "${_candidate}")
            set(_RAYLIB_DLL "${_candidate}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT DEFINED _RAYLIB_DLL)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not find raylib.dll under RAYLIB_DIR=${RAYLIB_DIR}")
    endif()
    get_filename_component(_RAYLIB_DLL_NAME "${_RAYLIB_DLL}" NAME)
    add_custom_command(TARGET dasModuleRaylibGen POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${_RAYLIB_DLL}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dasModuleRaylibGen>/${_RAYLIB_DLL_NAME}")
endif()
